meta.title: Mobile MACD — MNP Port-Out — Process Flow

lanes.name: Customer
lanes.hint: Initiates port-out at the other operator

lanes.name: NPAS / Other Operator
lanes.hint: Sends Port In request; activates line at other operator

lanes.name: Fulfilment / Retail Agent
lanes.hint: Validates ticket, MNP form, eligibility, and disconnection order

lanes.name: System (CRM)
lanes.hint: FNP_QUEUE, field validation, auto accept/reject, conditional acceptance

nodes.label: Customer Initiates Port Out
nodes.desc: If a customer wants to port out from VFQ, he/she visits the other operator's store and sends a Port In request through NPAS.

nodes.label: NPAS Sends Port In Request
nodes.desc: The other operator's Port In request comes into the CRM system automatically as a Trouble Ticket, in FNP_QUEUE.

nodes.label: Trouble Ticket in FNP_QUEUE
nodes.desc: Fulfilment Agent receives the Trouble Ticket in FNP_QUEUE in CRM for the Port Out request.

nodes.label: Agent Receives Trouble Ticket
nodes.desc: Fulfilment Agent picks up the Trouble Ticket from FNP_QUEUE in CRM for the Port Out request.

nodes.label: Validate Trouble Ticket Within Time Window
nodes.desc: Fulfilment agent shall validate the Trouble Ticket within 2 hrs of receiving it. Agent can change the verification time up to 24 hours.
controls: Fulfilment agent shall validate the Trouble ticket within 2 hrs it receives.
Agent can change verification time till 24 hours.

nodes.label: Validated Within Time Window?
nodes.desc: If the Trouble Ticket is not validated by the agent within the configured window, the system automatically accepts or rejects the request.
controls: If not validated by agent then system will automatically accepts/rejects the request.

nodes.label: System Auto Accept/Reject
nodes.desc: System automatically accepts or rejects the Port Out request when the agent does not validate the Trouble Ticket within the allowed window.

nodes.label: System Field Validation
nodes.desc: System shall validate fields like Customer Name, Customer Id, ID Type and Service Type.
controls: Systems shall validate fields like Customer Name, Customer Id, ID Type and Service Type.

nodes.label: Agent Validates MNP Form
nodes.desc: After system checks, Agent will validate the MNP form.
controls: After system checks Agent will validate the MNP form.

nodes.label: Agent Validates Port Out Eligibility
nodes.desc: Agent validates the customer's eligibility for Port Out after downloading the MNP Form from NPAS. Agent shall perform the following checks manually: (1) Customer Name, Customer ID, Service Type, Customer Segment verified against the customer record in Siebel, and Request Submission Date within 30 calendar days; (2) Signature on the form matched against the signature on the ID provided; (3) Outstanding dues, Plan Lock-ins, Star Number Lock-Ins, DOI Lock-in checked — if there are any billed charges, agent informs customer to pay the outstanding bills; (4) Agent calculates penalty charges for any lock-in and updates those in Unbilled charges, to be billed in the final settlement bill even if generated after successful Port Out from Vodafone.
controls: Customer Name, Customer ID, Service Type, Customer Segment shall be verified against the customer record in siebel. Request Submission Date should be within 30 calendar dates.
Signature on the form should match with the signature on the ID provided.
Outstanding dues, Plan Lock-ins, Star Number Lock-Ins, DOI Lock-in are checked. If there are any billed charges then agent shall inform customer to pay the outstanding bills.

Agent shall calculate the penalty charges if there are any Lock-in and update those in Unbilled charges. These unbilled charges will be billed in the final settlement bill (even if it's generated after the successful Port Out from Vodafone).

nodes.label: Outstanding Dues or Unbilled Amounts?
nodes.desc: If there are outstanding bills or unbilled amounts, system shall conditionally accept the request and wait for the payment. Once payment is cleared, system shall auto-accept the request.
controls: If there are outstanding bills or unbilled amounts, system shall conditionally accept the request and waits for the payment.
Once payment is cleared, system shall auto-accept the request.

nodes.label: Conditionally Accepted — Awaiting Payment
nodes.desc: Agent shall mark the Status as "Conditionally Accepted" if the customer is under any collection or if the customer has dues.
controls: Customer must clear outstanding dues before portability/disconnection completion.
Customer under commitment period may incur penalties or restrictions.

nodes.label: Payment Cleared — System Auto-Accepts
nodes.desc: Once payment is cleared, system shall auto-accept the request.
controls: Once payment is cleared, system shall auto-accept the request.

nodes.label: Agent Marks Final Status
nodes.desc: Once all checks are performed, Agent marks the status as Rejected/Accepted.
controls: Once all checks are performed Agent marks the status as Rejected/Accepted.

nodes.label: Port Out Rejected
nodes.desc: Trouble ticket closed with the request marked as Rejected.

nodes.label: Agent Checks Line Activated in NPAS
nodes.desc: Agent shall check in NPAS if the other operator has activated the line.
controls: Agent shall check in NPAS if the other operator has activated the line.

nodes.label: Other Operator Activates Line
nodes.desc: The other operator activates the line in NPAS, confirming the port-out to the donor (new) network.

nodes.label: Agent Initiates Disconnection Order
nodes.desc: If the other operator has activated the line, Agent shall initiate the Disconnection order in CRM. Disconnection Order steps shall be followed by agent as mentioned in usecase ID "MOB_RETL_DISC_001".
controls: If other operator has activated the line then Agent shall initiate Disconnection order in CRM.
Disconnection Order steps shall be followed by agent as mentioned in usecase ID "MOB_RETL_DISC_001".

nodes.label: Trouble Ticket Closed
nodes.desc: Once the Disconnection order is submitted, agent shall close the trouble ticket with appropriate comments.
controls: Once Disconnection order is submitted, agent shall close the trouble ticket with appropriate comments.
